data.source_title: Guidance for emergency departments: initial assessment
data.quantity: Handover ownership and conditional turnaround target

value.responsibility: hospital clinical responsibility begins on ambulance arrival

data.unit: minutes from arrival; prescribed target and ownership rule
data.source_evidence_basis: NHS England distinguishes pre-alerted patients needing a clinical team, who should be received immediately, from non-pre-alerted arrivals, whose handover should be completed within 15 minutes through locally agreed processes. It states hospital clinical responsibility starts at department arrival.
data.limitations: Prescriptive England guidance, not observed compliance, individual handover-time distribution, or US/RWJ policy.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Model arrival, clinical ownership, and handover completion as separate timestamped events; treat 15 minutes as an external policy target only, and ensure administrative steps do not delay clinical ownership.

provenance.acquisition_method: limited factual paraphrase; inspect record-level source_access and inspected_source_url for retrieval scope; source location retained

limitations: Prescriptive England guidance, not observed compliance, individual handover-time distribution, or US/RWJ policy.
